g.title: intent
g.text: Extract intent, targets, ingredients and preferences

g.title: edit
g.text: Edit independent queries + AND/OR required logic
Original hard conditions remain the final eligibility standard

g.title: prepare
g.text: Build positive editable queries + ingredient/numeric/manual filters
Meal and cuisine boost recall only; parallel branches

g.title: bm25
g.text: Text match + ingredient, cuisine and meal boosts
Original groups → any required → no required; retain strict hits

g.title: vector
g.text: One kNN request with original ingredient/numeric/manual filters

g.title: rank
g.text: Weighted RRF → Top 100 → Preference + Rating reranking
Return displayed results and ordered generation candidate IDs

g.title: results
g.text: Recipe cards, rank evidence and timings

g.title: generate
g.text: Read ordered RRF Top 100 IDs from ES
All local checks + pending semantic batches of 20
Broad required cuisine confirmed; meal explanation only

g.title: results->generate
g.text: Generate: query + intent + actual retrieval settings + Top 100 IDs

g.title: generate->model
g.text: Pending semantic conditions only; then qualified recipe context

g.title: answer
g.text: All checks, model usage and timing available
